reason: Living German-market singer with a current arena tour (29 Oct to 11 Nov 2026). Search results mix him with US actor Nico Santos, so a clear singer page with sourced tour and birth facts fills a gap. Official site and ticket listings confirm the tour; birth facts come from three press profiles that agree.

sources.title: Nico Santos Arena Tour 2026, Berlin, 30 October 2026
POV: Arena Tour 2026 in der Olympiahalle
TV-Tipp: Der deutsche Popstar von Mallorca

birthDate.note: Joyn, Mallorca Magazin and Promiflash agree. Official site does not state a birth date. One low-quality page gives 28 January 1993 and was disregarded.

birthPlace.note: Born as Nico Wellenbrink, son of actor and TV director Egon Wellenbrink (Joyn).

nationality.note: Promiflash lists nationality as Deutschland. Joyn describes Spain as his 'Heimatland' in the context of a Eurovision-style contest, not as nationality. Mallorca Magazin calls him a German musician. Dutch or Filipino heritage is not supported by any source found.

gapNote: Top results are dominated by the US actor Nico Santos (Superstore, Crazy Rich Asians). The German singer's tour dates, birth details and Mallorca background are scattered across ticket sites and tabloids. A single sourced page with the official tour list and disambiguation from the actor fills that gap.
